newsitem.title: USA: LaBarge increased Transmedica Int'l stake.
newsitem.headline: LaBarge increased Transmedica Int'l stake.

text.p: LaBarge Inc said Tuesday it has invested $2 million in Transmedica International Inc, raising its stake in the company to nearly 9.5 percent.
LaBarge makes the Laser Lancet, a portable medical laser, under an exclusive license with Transmedica.

LaBarge said fiscal fourth-quarter earnings for the three months ended June 30 rose to $0.20 per share from $0.12 during the same 1996 period. It said 1997 earnings for the year ended June 30 rose to $0.50 from $0.23 in fiscal 1996.

It said net earnings for the fourth quarter and fiscal year 1997 included a non-recurring tax benefit of $1,162,000 or $0.08 per share that resulted from a revaluation of the company's deferred tax assets, which include tax loss carryforwards. It said it expects to report future earnings on a fully taxed basis.
